output_list.reason: The mintToken function is only callable by the contract owner. It increases the balance of the target address and the total supply. If the target address is the contract itself, it will transfer the tokens to the contract itself. This will allow the contract to devalue the token. The mintToken function is only useful for initial token distribution. After that, the token should be distributed through a decentralized mechanism.
